card.name: Words before interests or motives
card.fires_on: Small words and nouns in general web prose where a noun like interests, motive, stake or duty could come next, e.g. 'their' before children, 'positive' before expectations, 'a' before duty.

modes.label: Possessives and determiners
modes.description: A word like their, they or a that is followed by a noun about wants, duties or interests.
modes.example: protecting the environment for<< their>> children and grandchildren

modes.label: Modal or adjective before a stance noun
modes.description: Words like would or positive that lead into plans, expectations or obligations.
modes.example: Normative influence is an influence to conform to the<< positive>> expectations of others.

modes.label: Debt and titles
modes.description: The word debt after forgiving, or titular before cardinal.
modes.example: it’s basically a matter of forgiving<< debt>> in one currency

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like motive, motives, interests, vested and stakes coming next.
card.plain: It fires on ordinary words in essay-style text and holds back words about motives and vested interests.
